Name: Fixed
What it means: Locked for the whole sequence. Copy it into every shot word for word.
When you use it: The field is part of identity, or a variant is in force and this field is not changing.

Name: Changed intentionally
What it means: This shot deliberately differs from the one before it. The change has a code.
When you use it: Wardrobe, condition, props, light or dressing shift on purpose. Never write C without the code.

Name: Unresolved
What it means: You have not decided yet. It is allowed to stay open, but not silently.
When you use it: A choice is deferred. Write what you will accept if the generation makes its own choice.

Name: Not applicable
What it means: The field does not apply to this shot. Say why in three words.
When you use it: No face in an insert, no prop in frame, no second character in the scene.
